# Security

If you find a security issue in BarDrop, please do **not** report it as a public issue. Report it privately via [“Report a vulnerability”](https://github.com/zzuuuiii/BarDrop/security/advisories/new) in the Security tab.

Only the [latest version](https://github.com/zzuuuiii/BarDrop/releases/latest) is supported.

Good to know: BarDrop sends no data about you. It connects to GitHub for updates, “What’s new” and, with plugins turned on, the plugin gallery; everything else (web images you drop, programs a plugin downloads after you allow it, a cloud service you connect) happens only when you ask for it. Before installing, updates are checked against the SHA-256 checksum GitHub publishes for the DMG, and gallery plugins and plugin programs against their own checksums.
